applyTo: ".github/agents/*.agent.md"

# Custom agent definitions

- Describe this repository as Foundry and distinguish Foundry APIs from upstream
  framework APIs and optional Needlr integrations.
- Do not hardcode current package versions or maintain project/file inventories.
  Resolve them from immutable repository manifests and verify the dependency
  graph when version accuracy matters.
- Treat rapidly changing upstream APIs as current-research questions and cite
  authoritative public sources.
- Keep domain expertise and repository context separate so stale local context
  cannot override current upstream evidence.
